scope: Local snapshot of all actual refs/remotes/origin branches; symbolic origin/HEAD excluded. No remote mutation or qualification claim.
same_and_different_definition: Paths changed from merge-base(candidate, branch) to branch, compared by their branch-tip and candidate blobs. Ancestry is a separate complete containment proof. A missing file is compared as missing, not ignored.
limits: This snapshot is not a live PR status or remote-CI result.
A differing blob or unique patch-id is not proof of unique behavior.
Superseded means no missing applicable intended behavior found in the reviewed source/test comparison, not byte equality or a formal equivalence proof.
Historical and deferred content stays on its original branch; it has not been silently merged or deleted.
